calculation.description: Fade each tradable asset's latest daily return relative to the cross-sectional median, scaled by its trailing 20-day volatility and winsorized to limit outliers. Signal is computed using data through the prior completed date.

validation.regime_notes: Full available 15-asset cross-asset universe; minimum 8 valid instruments per date. Overall daily gates pass, but recent subperiods are unstable: 2026-07-28/2026-12-31 IC 0.0065935 (113 dates), 2027-01-01/2027-03-24 IC -0.0104725 (58 dates). Interpret uncertainty conservatively given small cross-section and monitor drift.
